scope: Continue the experience/accessibility backlog with visitor-detail contents and reliable links into collapsed panels.
changes: Adopted the existing shared mobile contents component on all 23 published visitor-detail pages; desktop contents and chapter order retained.
Links to collapsed content reveal the target and enclosing disclosures on arrival, hash changes and ordinary same-page clicks, including repeated clicks.
Mobile chapter selection reveals hidden destinations before focusing a heading or disclosure summary; Escape behavior retained.
Initial/hash arrival never steals focus; only newly revealed targets receive explicit positioning. Modified clicks, external paths, query changes, new tabs and downloads keep native behavior.
Added the reusable navigation lesson to the design-system knowledge.

verification.mobile_contents: All 23 published detail pages contain desktop and mobile controls, with live fragment targets in reading order.
fragment_behavior: native summary remains in keyboard tab order
verification.search_boundary: 67 default/candidate comparisons and 11 proposed sitemap URLs pass; noindex remains the normal publication setting.

limitations: Same assistant implemented and checked the candidate; no independent review claimed.

Browser navigation retry failed because admin-enforced security policy could not be verified. No alternative browser used to bypass the restriction. Visual, real keyboard, screen-reader, zoom and device checks remain open.
Fragment interaction checks use synthetic DOM elements; they establish handler behavior, not actual browser timing or assistive-technology behavior.
No research claims, operating conditions, publication scope, private visitor data or search-indexing policy changed.
